watch_later_monitor.description: Monitor the authenticated Bilibili Watch Later list for new videos.

platform_subtitle.description: Read metadata and subtitle tracks exposed by Bilibili.

video_download.description: Download one authenticated source video for OCR or ASR.

hard_ocr_local.description: Extract hard subtitles from an existing local video.

hard_ocr_url.description: Download a video and extract hard subtitles.

audio_asr_local.description: Transcribe an existing local video with Qwen3-ASR.

audio_asr_url.description: Download a video and transcribe it with Qwen3-ASR.

python.description: Python 3.10 or newer with this project installed.

agent_action.description: Create .venv and install the core package plus MCP dependencies.

node.description: Node.js runtime required by the npm distribution of OpenCLI.

agent_action.description: Install a current Node.js LTS release using the host package manager.

opencli.description: OpenCLI command used for Bilibili transport and Browser Bridge state.

agent_action.description: Install the verified OpenCLI npm release, verify the opencli command, then persist its executable path when it is not on PATH.

watch_later_adapter.description: Repository-owned read-only OpenCLI plugin for Bilibili Watch Later.

agent_action.description: Install the packaged local Watch Later plugin from the repository root, then verify the video-subtitle-watch-later command.

browser_bridge.description: A connected OpenCLI Browser Bridge profile with an authenticated Bilibili tab.

human_action.description: Enable OpenCLI Browser Bridge in the browser, connect a profile, and log in to Bilibili. Give the profile alias to the Agent; never copy cookies into chat.

yt_dlp.description: yt-dlp executable used by OpenCLI downloads.

agent_action.description: Install the verified yt-dlp release in the selected Python environment and persist its executable path if it is not on PATH.

ffmpeg.description: FFmpeg executable used for media download merging and ASR audio extraction.

agent_action.description: Read the platform-aware plan, install FFmpeg with the host package manager, verify the detected version, and persist its executable path.

videocr.description: VideOCR CLI backend for complete hard-subtitle timelines.

agent_action.description: Inspect the host GPU, select a pinned runtime-lock variant, show its byte size, and only after confirmation download and SHA-256 verify the VideOCR 1.5.1 archive.

asr_python.description: Separate Python environment containing CUDA PyTorch and qwen-asr.

agent_action.description: Inspect the host NVIDIA driver, select a pinned torch profile, then create and verify an isolated qwen-asr==0.0.6 environment only after confirmation.

qwen_asr_model.description: Local Qwen3-ASR model directory; setup never approves an implicit first-run download.

agent_action.description: After confirming disk and network cost, download Qwen3-ASR-1.7B at the pinned revision, write a file-hash receipt, verify it, and persist its local directory.

qwen_aligner_model.description: Local Qwen3 Forced Aligner directory; setup never approves an implicit first-run download.

agent_action.description: After confirming disk and network cost, download Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B at the pinned revision, write a file-hash receipt, verify it, and persist its local directory.

cuda.description: A CUDA-capable GPU visible to the Qwen3-ASR Python environment.

human_action.description: If no compatible GPU is available, choose another ASR backend or provide a machine with supported NVIDIA drivers; the Skill cannot manufacture this capability.
